title.value: B ROKEN N EURAL S CALING L AWS
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document, indicating the focus on neural scaling laws in deep learning.
title.quote: B ROKEN N EURAL S CALING L AWS Ethan Caballero Mila, McGill University...

extractions.description: This paper introduces a broken neural scaling law (BNSL) that effectively models and predicts the scaling behavior of deep neural networks across various architectures and tasks. The BNSL is a smoothly connected piecewise linear function that outperforms traditional power law models in capturing non-monotonic behaviors such as double descent and inflection points. The paper explores the application of BNSL in a wide range of tasks, demonstrating its superior extrapolation capabilities compared to other models. The authors also discuss the implications of their findings for AI alignment and safety.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with the mathematical modeling of neural scaling laws and their application in improving the predictive accuracy of neural network performance at scale. It does not focus specifically on any eco-responsible AI category, such as climate change, pollution control, or natural systems protection.
primary_category.quote: This set includes large-scale vision, language, audio, video, diffusion, generative modeling, multimodal learning, contrastive learning, AI alignment, robotics, out-of-distribution generalization, continual learning, uncertainty estimation / calibration, out-of-distribution detection, adversarial robustness, molecules, computer programming/coding, math word problems, arithmetic, unsupervised/selfsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning...
